introduction_transcript:
Welcome back to the AI Confidence Academy. This is Phase Two, Journey Six, Lesson One: Recognize Capability and Connect It to Value.

You have built, reviewed, improved and tested work across the course. This final journey brings that evidence together. Today you will explain what you can do, who that work can help, and what the evidence actually supports.

Saying I used an AI tool describes an activity. Saying I designed and tested a reviewed proposal workflow using fictional cases describes a capability you can show. The difference is the work behind the statement.

We will use five practical verbs: explain, do, review, improve and show. Each statement needs a supporting example and an honest limit. Capability does not automatically give you a professional title, permission to act, or a qualification you have not earned.

You will create an inventory of ten capabilities from your own course work. Then develop three Value Connections, select the two strongest, and write one short Evidence Story for your continuing project. A Value Connection identifies your capability, its context, the people it serves, the improvement and the supporting evidence.

Your Evidence Story will explain the purpose, your action, the AI role, your judgment, the result and the remaining limit. Remove private details and label fictional, sanitized or recreated examples accurately.

Keep the same Project Record and connected workbook. By the end, you will explain one capability in a professional setting and show the work that supports it. AI assists. Humans verify. Let's begin.
